reviews.text: Delivery delayed by a week. Only got the delivery sorted after emailing about my order. They sent the wrong product and said they didn’t carry the product I bought anymore. Then wanted to replace my order with another product that had less quantity than what I originally ordered. Just an awful experience altogether.

Really impressed with the customer service at Naturally Urban. They were friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful when I had questions about products. The whole process was easy from ordering to delivery. Great experience.

Such a quick and reliable service for all your pets' needs. I love it! Thank you! It really takes a lot of mental load off of me knowing that I would be getting what I ordered on time.

P.S for any cat owners that are interested in tofu based cat litter, Naturally Urban sells Pidan Tofu Cat litter (very reasonably priced too) which keeps odours under control. One of the best tofu cat litters in the market.

Been off and on with these amazing fellows for nearly 9 years and I can't praise them enough- excellent communication, SO friendly and accommodating! I rave about them to my co-workers and anyone who will listen (no more carrying those heavy bags home alone on the bus!!)!
14/10 recommend to anyone considering supporting local folks and furry cuties :)
Don't forget to check out their Instagram for this week's feature pet poster!
Love this local store! Friendly owner and great items. Best to support locals businesses.

I’ve been using Naturally Urban for years, and they’ve been fantastic every single time. Their customer service is outstanding, and their deliveries are always incredibly prompt and reliable.

As a busy pet owner, having quality food show up at my door without having to think about it is a huge convenience. It saves me time, and I know my pet is getting great products.

If you have a hectic schedule and want reliable service from a company that genuinely cares, Naturally Urban is an absolute no-brainer. Highly recommend!
I have ordered online several times and they always delivered in a timely manner.  And delivery is FREE!
They are very reliable, friendly and fast. Sammy made sure to get my delivery to my door even when I wasn’t there to buzz in. Thanks!

My wife and I order form her often!
Always swift and easy! :D
We recommend these guys to our friends often, haha
Great company, very friendly staff, and speedy delivery (and subscription service) makes life with 2 cats so much easier. Rylie was super helpful, made an extra effort to make my order run smoothly.

Love this local pet food store.  Deliveries are prompt.  Service is great.  Selection is good!  Thanks Naturally Urban.
Update March 9:  and the delivery people (Sammy) are the best!

Customer service and delivery is excellent. Sammie called me to talk about specifics about delivering and warned me ahead of time the bag of litter I ordered had a small hole in the top. Great service.
So nice having a bag of dog food delivered to your front door at no extra cost.
Great litter - natural, clumps without falling apart so it lasts longer, absorbs all urine smell, limited tracking. Great delivery service. Fair pricing. Local company.

After some health issues with my kitties I did a tonne of research looking into a special dietary food that would work for both of them that was NOT science diet, royal canin or purina, and the one I found to try was from Italy and seemingly not available anywhere in the city. But then, luckily it came up online at Naturally Urban. I popped into the store and the person working was an absolute gem and super helpful. I grabbed the last bag of kibble and some single tins of the wet food to try and both my cats went crazy for it so have now switched over to it with hopefully lasting success! I’ve popped in a few more times for more and have found it in stock each time and the same person working just as helpful and lovely as the first time. So happy I found this hidden gem and will definitely be back!
They have the hard to find food I needed for my dog, and free fast delivery to my door! Awesome experience!

Excellent service. Love having delivery. The Pidan tofu-based cat litter we buy is a great product too. We used to use a different popular brand but I found the odour was still too strong. This stuff works really well.

Having a local shop that can deliver my cat food on a subscription basis is great! Getting free shipping and a discount for having said subscription is even better! Thank you, Naturally Urban Pet Store, for taking this task off my plate :)

Happily subscribed to having our favorite cat tofu litter delivered monthly because of their great pricing and amazing service! Never looked back on going to other pet stores in person and having to buy them individually. Always so speedy and makes it on our doorstep every time. My wife, cats and I are extremely satisfied with their exceptional service 🐈🐈‍⬛

I shop for cat food here and they carry brands that barely anyone else does. And even when other stores have them, these guys always have the best prices. Delivery is super quick every time too. Honestly, if that is not 5 star service, I do not know what is.

Never got what I paid for. Called and was told it would have already been delivered. I'd change this review if I get my purchase but luckily there are other options out there and it wasn't a huge loss of income

This little guy is going without litter he'd use until I get a replacement product or the package is here. I have to clean the floors with paper towels every few hours

So nice to deal with and they followed up on my request for a certain type of dog food so well!
Thank you 😊 …
Very convenient. Reasonable pricing, fast delivery. Products and service have always been excellent.

We have been getting our freeze dried dog food from Naturally Urban for 5 years. Our dog is 14 now and his coat is so shiny! We live out in Chilliwack and are thankful for their delivery service!! Always friendly and accomodating staff when ordering from them.
Great prices, products and service. Delivery is fast and convenient. Thank you!!
excellent selection for my cats and dog. And efficient prompt delivery  FOR FREE which is amazing.

Great selection. Found our favorite cat tofu litter here when my previous source stopped carrying it. Delivery is always very quick, which is helpful when we need it in a pinch. Appreciate the discount with subscription.
very nice customer service！ hope they can have weruva‘s products！

Naturally Urban is a fantastic, local, small business that offers premium dog food, treats, and apparel for dogs of all shapes sizes. They have a great selection and their customer service is superb. I’m happy to support them and spread the word about how great they are.
Great products and quick delivery service

Excellent selection of products for my cats. I can't believe delivery within Vancouver is free, especially with how fast the service is! I really appreciate the selection of local/Canadian brands they stock and the option to set up recurring orders at odd intervals (6 weeks, 7 weeks, etc.) Would highly recommend to any pet owner!
Great prices and great service.
Great service! My orders are always accurate and arrive quickly. I love the convenience of the delivery service.
Love the large sizes of Farmina N&D for my cat and Orijen for my dog. The free shipping keeps me coming back!

I’ve been ordering online every month from Calgary since October and my experience has been nothing but positive!! My dog is super picky and wont eat his meals all the time, but he will if he knows he will be getting these treats afterwards!! I cannot find these treats in Calgary and that is how I discovered Naturally Urban! Since I am in the next province over, I buy in bulk (which really puts a huge smile on my dog’s face!) He was so excited from the last shipment! and shipping has been pretty quick as well! If I visit Vancouver one day, I’II definitely come by and say Hi! Thank you Naturally Urban!
Excellent  service,  fabulous products.. love this company..Gwen and Rob
Good service, good staff and super quick delivery
Not customer friendly.  Sold me a leash for $60.  Be careful what they try to sell you.
